title: What Should We Build Next?
instructions: These are the features our customers have asked for most often. Choose the ones that would make the biggest difference to your work and put them in priority order, most important first. Then add one feature of your own that is not offered.

options.text: offline mode that syncs when you reconnect
keyboard shortcuts for every common action
a dark theme that respects the system setting
share a read-only link without an account
search across everything, not just the current page
undo, on everything, for at least a day
an audit log of who changed what
